generator: Built-in image_gen creates frame artwork; Node.js + Sharp assembles GIF and sprite atlases. Explicit image2.5 selection is not exposed.

pixelCharacters.export: Nearest-neighbor sampling, binary alpha and connected-silhouette normalization remove disconnected matte specks; character drawing is generated by image_gen.

prompts.name: about-night-frames
prompts.prompt: Create a 4 by 4 ANIMATION CONTACT SHEET, exactly FOUR equal square columns and FOUR equal square rows, edge-to-edge with NO gutters or grid lines. All 16 cells are sequential frames of ONE SINGLE CLOSE-UP anime portrait for a looping GIF, NOT different character designs. Use the supplied day portrait as the style and facial identity reference; transform her to Black Hanekawa's night form: snowy white flowing hair, two small white cat ears, golden cat eyes, NO glasses, rosy cheeks, fully covering charcoal collared blouse and small burgundy ribbon. Crop head and shoulders only, camera locked, head size and location locked, generous headroom so ears fit in every cell. Keep the reference's hand-painted film texture, delicate dark linework, warm rim light, evening navy/umber background. Every cell has the SAME solid dark navy-brown evening backdrop. Motion is subtle, smooth and loopable: row 1 frames 1-4 relaxed open eyes and slight hair sway; row 2 frames 5-8 gradually blinking closed then opening; row 3 frames 9-12 a tiny warm smile and slight breathing; row 4 frames 13-16 settle back to exactly frame 1. Each frame must be a complete clean portrait. No speech balloons, no punctuation, no captions, no numbers, no labels, no border, no UI. Square overall canvas. The entire final image is the precisely aligned 4x4 frame sheet. Nonsexual character portrait.

prompts.name: pixel-day-sheet
prompts.prompt: Create a production-ready game PIXEL ART SPRITE SHEET of Tsubasa Hanekawa, based on the supplied chibi reference. STRICT layout: square canvas, exactly 4 equal columns by 4 equal rows, 16 sprites total, NO gutters, no grid lines, no labels. Actual transparent alpha background in all empty areas. Each cell represents a 64x64 logical pixel sprite enlarged with crisp hard square pixel edges, limited warm 16-color palette, absolutely no soft antialiasing, no glow, no painted background. Full-body tiny super-deformed character: oversized dark brown-haired head, round glasses, large reddish-brown eyes, side braid with muted-gold ribbon, modest pink collared blouse with dark bow, charcoal skirt, dark tights and small shoes. Cute, readable, friendly. All sprites have identical proportions and head size, face slightly toward viewer's right, centered in each cell, consistent feet baseline near bottom with safe margin for hair and gestures. ROW 1 is 4 sequential IDLE frames: eyes open, half-blink, closed-blink, open, very subtle breathing. ROW 2 is 4 sequential WALK RIGHT frames: clear alternating leg strides and arm swing, consistent ground line. ROW 3 is 4 sequential WAVING frames: right hand low, raised, wave left, wave right. ROW 4 is 4 sequential SMALL HAPPY JUMP frames: crouch, takeoff, arms raised, landing. Preserve the original reference's recognizable cute face, side braid and outfit while translating to beautiful crisp retro game pixel art. Include the ENTIRE head and feet inside every cell. No extra cats, no props, no text, no outlines around the cells. This sheet will be cropped into its 16 exact equal cells for real animation.

prompts.name: pixel-night-sheet
prompts.prompt: Edit this exact 4 by 4 pixel-art character animation sprite sheet into Black Hanekawa's NIGHT FORM. Preserve the EXACT 4-column 4-row grid, the identical 16 poses, head/body proportions, positions, feet baselines, pixel size, animation timing implied by poses, and the original chunky limited-palette pixel art style. Change only the character appearance in EVERY cell: snowy white hair and white braid with muted-gold ribbon, TWO small white cat ears with pink inner ears, golden cat eyes, NO glasses, dark charcoal collared blouse with small burgundy bow, charcoal skirt, dark tights and shoes. Preserve the same sweet expressive face and blush. Row 1 remains four idle/blink frames; row 2 the same four walk frames; row 3 the same four waving frames; row 4 the same four jump frames. No pose changes, no new props, no cell resizing, no grid lines, no captions, no lettering, no white outline. Keep genuine transparent alpha around each sprite and in all empty sheet areas. The result must be a perfectly matching night variant of this supplied day sprite sheet, ready to crop into equal cells.
